questions_and_answers.question_text: What do you say in this situation? You meet your next door neighbor in the morning on a cold day.

answers.answer_text: Ohayoo gozaimasu. Samui desu ne. (お早うございます。寒いですね。)

questions_and_answers.question_text: What do you say in this situation? You meet a neighborhood shopkeeper in the evening. The weather is nasty.

answers.answer_text: Konbanwa. Iya na otenki desu ne. (今晩は。いやなお天気ですね。)

questions_and_answers.question_text: What do you say in this situation? You meet someone who lives in your apartment building during the day. It's a very hot day.

answers.answer_text: Konnichiwa. Atsui desu ne. (今日は。暑いですね。)

questions_and_answers.question_text: What do you say in this situation? You meet a neighborhood shopkeeper in the morning. The weather is beautiful.

answers.answer_text: Ohayoo gozaimasu. Ii otenki desu ne. (お早うございます。いいお天気ですね。)

questions_and_answers.question_text: What do you say in this situation? You come home from a concert. The babysitter greets you.

answers.answer_text: Tadaima. (ただいま。) — responding to the babysitter's Okaerinasai.

questions_and_answers.question_text: What do you say in this situation? You meet a neighborhood shopkeeper who greets you by asking 'Are you going out somewhere?' (Dokoka e odekake desu ka?)

answers.answer_text: Ee, chotto (soko made). (ええ、ちょっと(そこまで)。)

questions_and_answers.question_text: What do you say in this situation? You meet a next door neighbor who asks 'Are you returning home now?' (Ima okaeri desu ka?)
